1. This offer is valid only for Sampath Mastercard, Visa Corporate Credit Cardholders.

2. In order to enjoy the promotion, the full payment needs to be settled with a Sampath Mastercard, Visa Corporate Credit Card.

4. Max 03 trips will be allowed per user during the offer period.

5. In the event where the maximum trips exceed, the bank may charge the excess discount value from the Cardholder on a subsequent date.

6. This offer cannot be combined with any other existing offers or vouchers.

7. The Bank accepts no responsibility in any way for any goods or services purchased and any dispute relating to same should be resolved by the cardholder directly with the partner and any claim by the cardholder against the partner will not relive the cardholder from his/ her obligation or repayment to the Bank.

9. The general terms & conditions of Sampath Bank PLC & Kangaroo Cabs shall apply.

10. In the event of any dispute, the decision of the Bank shall be final.

11. The Bank reserves the right to modify or change the terms & conditions of the offer.

12. The Bank reserves the right to amend/ withdraw this offer at its sole discretion.
